enrich.rationale: Residual-driven active learning will preferentially add solves where the model’s out-of-fold error is predicted highest in those correlated input regions, yielding better RMSE reduction per new sample than blind regeneration or more tuning.

diagnosis: The current bottleneck is sample coverage in specific input directions (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip) causing structured residuals, not split noise or hyperparameter plateauing.
